Container.Name: u1-print-bridge-slicer
Container.Overview: Headless OrcaSlicer worker for the Snapmaker U1 one-click print bridge. Shares its job queue with the api container through the same Data path. No web UI.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Job database and slice artifacts. MUST be the same path in the api and slicer containers.

Config.Name: Data Dir
Config.Description: Data directory inside the container. Keep /data.
